title: Set up doc storage
summary: Stand up the company’s shared document system — pick a provider, configure the workspace, and bring the existing documents in.

parts.title: Choose storage provider
parts.guidance: Compare storage options against the company's document types, access needs, current collaboration tools, and migration effort. Check company ownership, external sharing, export, and the features available in the proposed plan. Ask the people handling sensitive records where the current setup fails them. Recommend a provider with the required access boundaries and manageable cost, identifying any unresolved retention or migration requirement before the budget owner commits.

parts.title: Create the account and set the folder structure
parts.guidance: Create the storage workspace with company-controlled administration and recovery. Organize folders or libraries by document ownership, with distinct access boundaries for employee files, legal and financial records, and everyday collaboration. Give each area a maintainer and set the default sharing behavior. Check a representative document with the intended reader and editor before importing that area, looking for unexpected inherited permissions.

parts.title: Share the workspace with the team
parts.guidance: Map teammates to the storage areas they need, using groups where the service supports them. Check external collaborators separately and review whether shared links expose more than intended. Have the workspace administrator confirm new invitations and access grants, then distribute the starting link and a short filing guide. Help the first users locate and work on their documents, and resolve missing access without broadening every folder to the whole team.

parts.title: Import existing company documents
parts.guidance: Inventory the source documents, owners, permissions, and links that other work relies on. Choose destinations and decide how to handle duplicates and superseded versions before importing. Move or copy through the provider's supported path, reconciling files and failures as each area completes. Check important documents and links with their users. Keep original sources available until the migration owner accepts the result and authorizes cleanup, especially where document history or permissions did not transfer.

metadata.supportReason: Account creation is manual; sharing and document import run over the provider APIs.
